views.label: lighting: ancient rock against the sun (backlit)
views.js: () => { const g = __game, G = g.scene.course.gallery, X = j => G.x0 + j * G.step, S = g.scene.course.env.sunDir, x = X(0), c = [x, 0, G.z]; const u = [-S.z, 0, S.x], ul = Math.hypot(u[0], u[2]) || 1, k = [-S.x, -S.y * 0.3, -S.z]; return { pos: [c[0] + k[0] * 230, c[1] + k[1] * 230 + 30, c[2] + k[2] * 230], at: c, fov: 42 }; }

views.label: landmark 1 (spires) from the racing line
views.js: () => { const g = __game, t = g.scene.race.track, N = t.N, M = g.scene.course.marks; const m = M[0]; let b = 0, bd = 1e18; for (let k = 0; k < N; k++) { const d = t.pos[k].distSq(m.p); if (d < bd) { bd = d; b = k; } } const p = t.pos[b]; return { pos: [p.x, p.y + 12, p.z], at: [m.p.x, m.p.y, m.p.z], fov: 64 }; }
